mapper.sql:
select gameagent, gameplame, sum(gamepepole) as gamepepole, sum(gametouzhu) as gametouzhu, sum(gamecell) as gamecell, sum(gamebet) as gamebet, sum(gameprofit) as gameprofit, CONCAT( ROUND( sum( gameprofit ) / sum( gamecell ) * 100, 2 ), '%' ) as bili,
CONCAT( #{begindate}, ' - ', #{endDate} ) as begindate
begindate
from report_plam_games
mapper.select:
select gameplame, SUM(gamecell) as gamecell, SUM(gamecell) - SUM(plampfit) as paicai, SUM(plampfit) as gameprofit from report_plam_games
and gameplame = #{gameplame}
AND begindate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{begindate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND begindate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY gameplame UNION all select '送礼金额' as liveprop, '0' as gamecell, '0' as paicai, SUM(ticket) from ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day where id like concat(#{dateTime}, '%') and ticket is not NULL UNION all SELECT '主播结算打码' AS liveprop, '0' AS gamecell, '0' AS paicai, SUM( lottery_cost ) FROM ${dbLive}.live_host_wage_day WHERE id LIKE concat(#{dateTime}, '%') and lottery_cost is not NULL UNION ALL select '坐骑金额' as liveprop,'0' as gamecell,'0' as paicai,SUM(total_diamonds)from ${dbLive}.live_video_prop where p_user_id not in (select id from member_info where STATUS = 2 ) AND prop_id = '-2'
AND create_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{begindate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND create_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

select SUM(plampfit) as countBetMoney from report_plam_games
and gameplame = #{gameplame}
AND date_format(begindate,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{begindate},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(begindate,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endDate},'%y%m%d')
